## devonthink
CRITICAL — Database package safety: DEVONthink databases are stored as packages (.dtBase2) or sparse images (.dtSparse, .dtArchive). Never modify, rename, move, or delete files inside a database package directly via the filesystem. All record and content operations must go through this MCP server or, as a fallback, via AppleScript. Direct filesystem manipulation will corrupt the database and cause irreversible data loss.

Batch operations: Use the uuids array parameter instead of sequential single-record calls for tag, update, move, trash, duplicate, replicate, and export operations. Batch mode is faster, reduces round trips, and returns a summary with succeeded/failed counts.

Avoiding duplicates: Use lookup_records (by name, URL, path, filename, or comment) before create_record to check whether a record already exists.

Content editing: Prefer update_record_content with mode append or insert over replace for large documents. Replace mode requires sending the entire new content and risks accidental data loss if the content is incomplete.

Group hierarchies: Use create_group_path to create nested group structures in a single call (like mkdir -p) rather than sequential create_record calls.

AI-powered tools: classify_record and find_similar_records use DEVONthink's built-in AI algorithms and proprietary training data — they provide organizational suggestions that complement, not duplicate, your own capabilities.

Record enrichment: resolve_doi_metadata and resolve_book_metadata can enrich existing records with bibliographic metadata by passing the record's uuid — there is no need to create a new record.

AI exclusion: Records marked as excluded from AI access (excludeFromChat) are protected in two ways. (1) Input protection: any tool that receives such a record's UUID as an argument refuses to operate on it and returns an error. (2) Output protection: result lists from tools like search_records, classify_record, find_similar_records, get_record_children, get_record_duplicates, and the link traversal tools are filt… [truncated]

1	# Handoff — remaining refactoring, tidy-up & test improvements
2	
3	**Date:** 2026-07-09
4	**Scope:** Everything still open after the test-suite-cleanup epic, plus full docs for the
5	**new route/layout render-test system** the next agent will build on.
6	
7	> Scratch/local, under `.scratch/` (gitignored). The running blow-by-blow log of the
8	> completed epic is in `handoff-test-suite-cleanup.md`; **this** doc is the forward-looking
9	> summary. Read `CLAUDE.md` (repo root) and `docs/product-backlog.md` first.
10	
11	---
12	
13	## 0. Status snapshot (as of this handoff)
14	
15	- **All green:** `npm run check` (svelte-check, whole project) = **0 errors / 0 warnings**;
16	  full unit suite ≈ **1375 passed / 8 skipped**; ESLint clean on every file touched this epic.
17	- **Uncommitted:** only 2 Prettier fixes to `ExpenseService.{getExpenses,categoryAssignment}.spec.ts`.
18	  Humans commit — do **not** `git commit`.
19	- **Test count dropped over the epic (1671 → ~1375) on purpose:** hollow tests (source-introspection,
20	  reimplemented-logic, RED-phase scaffolding, tautologies) were replaced by fewer, stronger behavior
21	  tests. Lower count = higher signal.
22	
23	### What the epic already finished (don't redo)
24	- **§2a** — all 10 `readFileSync`-their-own-source introspection specs → real behavior tests or deleted.
25	- **§2b** — split 3 oversized specs (`ExpenseService`, `expenses-page-filters`, `ReceiptService`);
26	  `ReceiptService.split.spec.ts` left intact (single concern).
27	- **§2c** — routed inline row-building through builders where it was a real duplicate.
28	- **Reimplemented-logic** — the `expenses-filters.*` specs (tested their own inline `.filter()` copies)
29	  → deleted/redirected to real owners (`sharedDateFilter.spec`, `dateValidation.spec`, render tests).
30	- **Unimplemented/placeholder** — `CategoryService.spec.ts` stale TDD RED-phase scaffolding stripped
31	  (+ typed mock, 24 `any`→0); `CSVExportService` two empty `it.skip` browser placeholders → real
32	  browser tests in `CSVExportService.svelte.spec.ts`.
33	- **Foreign-currency amount cell** — render tests on both pages; both math sites teeth-proven.
34	
35	---
36	
37	## 1. THE ROUTE/LAYOUT RENDER-TEST SYSTEM (new — read before writing any page/component test)
38	
39	**Why it exists:** SvelteKit route/layout components import `$app/stores`, `$app/navigation`,
40	`$app/paths`, and `$lib/supabaseClient` (a module-level Supabase singleton created at import → throws /
41	hits the network in a test). They also `new SomeService(supabase)` and load data on mount. The harness
42	mocks those boundaries so a **real** `+layout.svelte` / `+page.svelte` / component renders in the browser.
43	
44	### 1.1 Files
45	- `src/lib/tests/harness/appMocks.ts` — the controllable mocks + service stubs (the heart of the system).
46	- `src/lib/tests/harness/LayoutHarness.svelte` — wraps the real `+layout.svelte` with a marker child so
47	  the auth-gate ("does page content render?") is assertable.
48	- Existing render specs to copy from: `layout-render.svelte.spec.ts`, `expenses-page.svelte.spec.ts`,
49	  `receipts-page.svelte.spec.ts`, `expenses-page-receipt-modal.svelte.spec.ts`, `profile-page.svelte.spec.ts`,
50	  `receipt-image-click.svelte.spec.ts`, `ReceiptEditModal.svelte.spec.ts`, `CSVExportService.svelte.spec.ts`.
51	  Component-level examples: `DataTable.svelte.spec.ts`, `FilteredEmptyState.svelte.spec.ts`.
52	
53	### 1.2 HARD naming/env rule
54	Render tests run in the **`client`** (Playwright/browser) vitest project, whose include glob is
55	`src/**/*.svelte.{test,spec}.{js,ts}`. **The file MUST be named `*.svelte.spec.ts`** (even if it renders
56	no Svelte component — e.g. `CSVExportService.svelte.spec.ts` just needs the DOM). A plain `*.spec.ts`
57	runs in the node `server` project (no DOM) and will fail. Projects are configured in `vite.config.ts`.
58	
59	### 1.3 Controllable API (all exported from `harness/appMocks.ts`)
60	- `pageStore` — the `$app/stores` `page` store; `setRoute(pathname, search?)` points it at a URL.
61	- `setSession(session | null)` + `fakeSession(userId?)` — drive auth. `fakeSession()` carries
62	  `user.id/email/created_at`. `setSessionPending()` makes `getSession()` hang (to assert a Loading state).
63	- `supabaseMock` — auth (`getSession`/`getUser`/`onAuthStateChange`/`signOut`) + a `from()` that backs the
64	  `profiles` table via `setProfile(row | null)` / `makeProfile(overrides)` (null → PGRST116 "no rows").
65	- Service stubs (mock the module, drive the data): `ReceiptServiceStub` + `setReceipts(rows)`;
66	  `ExpenseServiceStub` + `setExpenses(rows)`; `CategoryServiceStub` + `setCategories(rows)`.
67	- `resetHarness()` — clears everything; call in `beforeEach`.
68	
69	### 1.4 Skeleton of a new page render test
70	```ts
71	import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
72	import { render } from 'vitest-browser-svelte';
73	import { makeExpense } from './builders/rowBuilders';
74	import { pageStore, supabaseMock, ExpenseServiceStub, CategoryServiceStub, ReceiptServiceStub,
75	         setExpenses, setSession, fakeSession, resetHarness } from './harness/appMocks';
76	
77	// vi.mock is hoisted per-file — these MUST be in each spec (can't be shared via import).
78	vi.mock('$app/stores', () => ({ page: pageStore }));
79	vi.mock('$lib/supabaseClient', () => ({ supabase: supabaseMock }));
80	vi.mock('$app/navigation', () => ({ goto: () => {}, replaceState: () => {} }));
81	vi.mock('$app/paths', () => ({ resolve: (p: string) => p }));
82	vi.mock('$lib/utils/signedUrl', () => ({ getSignedReceiptUrls: async () => ({}), getSignedReceiptUrl: async () => null }));
83	vi.mock('$lib/utils/familyUtils', () => ({ getDefaultFamilyId: async () => 'family-1' })); // expenses page needs a family id
84	vi.mock('$lib/services/ExpenseService', () => ({ ExpenseService: ExpenseServiceStub }));
85	vi.mock('$lib/services/CategoryService', () => ({ CategoryService: CategoryServiceStub }));
86	vi.mock('$lib/services/ReceiptService', () => ({ ReceiptService: ReceiptServiceStub }));
87	
88	import ExpensesPage from '../../routes/expenses/+page.svelte';
89	
90	describe('...', () => {
91	  beforeEach(resetHarness);
92	  it('...', async () => {
93	    setSession(fakeSession());
94	    setExpenses([makeExpense({ /* ... */ })]);
95	    const screen = render(ExpensesPage);
96	    await expect.element(screen.getByText('...')).toBeVisible();
97	  });
98	});
99	```
100	Notes: the **receipts** page short-circuits category loading if `getDefaultFamilyId` returns `null`
101	(simpler); the **expenses** page renders a "No family" error unless it returns a real id. Check each
102	page's `onMount` for which services/utils it actually calls and stub only those.
103	
104	### 1.5 Locator gotchas (these cost real time — learn them)
105	- `getByText` is **substring + case-insensitive** (Playwright). Avoid overlapping fixtures
106	  ("Categorized" ⊂ "Uncategorized"); use distinct merchant names ('Alpha Store'/'Beta Store') or `{ exact: true }`.
107	- **DataTable** only marks **sortable** headers `role="columnheader"`; non-sortable headers are plain `<th>`
108	  (role `cell`). Assert non-sortable columns by their cell content, not `getByRole('columnheader')`.
109	- Filter toggles / dropdown options can collide with row **category-cell** buttons of the same text.
110	  The FilterPanel renders **above** the table, so `.first()` targets the filter control. The expenses
111	  Category dropdown is `hidden`-class-toggled: click the "Category" button first, then `.first()` the option.
112	- **BOM / binary asserts:** `Blob.text()` strips a leading UTF-8 BOM per spec — assert raw bytes
113	  (`new Uint8Array(await blob.arrayBuffer())` → `EF BB BF`) instead of `text.startsWith('﻿')`.
114	- Cross-test async bleed: the heavy pages have long async mount chains; keep fixtures per-test and reset in
115	  `beforeEach`. If a "count/summary" assertion flakes, it's usually a locator collision, not the harness.
116	
117	### 1.6 What it does NOT cover (still seam-only)
118	`#{#ath1c}` (protected pages must not self-redirect to `/login`) stays a **source** check in
119	`auth-route-guard.spec.ts` — it's an absence-of-anti-pattern across 4 page files, orthogonal to render.
120	Fine to leave; convert only if you build per-page unauthenticated-render coverage.
121	
122	---
123	
124	## 2. REMAINING WORK
125	
126	### 2.A Remaining test-quality items (the "second frontier")
127	- **Audit for more reimplemented-logic specs.** The `expenses-filters.*` set was the one I'd concretely
128	  identified; I did **not** exhaustively sweep. Heuristic: `grep -rn "function \(filter\|calculate\|parse\|generate\)" src --include="*.spec.ts"` — spec-local helpers that then assert their **own** output are hollow.
129	  Convert each to its real owner (util spec or a render test), like §-reimplemented-logic did.
130	- **Hollow "has-method" checks (~7, low value).** `expect(typeof service.X).toBe('function')` in
131	  `ExpenseService.vendorRules/categoryAssignment/getExpenses`, `ReceiptService.split/bulk`,
132	  `CategoryDropdown.spec`. A method existing is guaranteed by the class + TS. Optional: delete each
133	  (one per suite) — churn > benefit, so left as-is.
134	- **`family-category-visibility.spec.ts` — env-gated integration.** Gated by
135	  `describeIf(SUPABASE_URL && SERVICE_KEY)` → **never runs in CI** (no service role key; no seed harness
136	  exists). Real assertions, just never executed. Decision needed: keep as a real-DB integration suite
137	  (leave), or delete if integration tests will never run. Left intact for now.
138	- **`ReceiptService.split.spec.ts` (1024 lines) — deliberately NOT split.** Single cohesive concern
139	  (receipt-split) with a shared module-level `beforeEach`; concern-splitting adds duplication for no gain.
140	- **`auth-route-guard.spec.ts`** — trimmed to just the `#{#ath1c}` residual source guard (see §1.6).
141	- **Weak-test trap reminder (project memory):** some specs reimplement logic inline or grep source —
142	  don't over-trust green. `ReceiptImageViewer.spec.ts` was flagged historically as an example.
143	
144	### 2.B Production refactoring backlog (RF-04 → RF-13, all OPEN)
145	Full detail in `docs/refactoring-backlog.md` (reference doc — don't grow a parallel list). RF-01–03 done;
146	RF-D1/D2 deferred. Surface as one-liners in `docs/product-backlog.md` (single working list). Open:
147	- **RF-04** — de-duplicate `findPotentialMatches` / `findPotentialMatchesForTransaction` copy-paste pair.
148	- **RF-05** — break up long methods in the service layer.
149	- **RF-06** — bundle matching tolerances (Long Parameter List / Data Clump) into one object *(correctness-adjacent)*.
150	- **RF-07** — reconcile the singleton-vs-DI split across services.
151	- **RF-08** — replace `any` with precise types where one already exists *(partly chipped at: CategoryService/dateValidation specs)*.
152	- **RF-09** — collapse the three inconsistent ways to resolve a row's Category into one.
153	- **RF-10** — move UI display massaging out of `ReconciliationService` (Feature Envy).
154	- **RF-11** — replace the `normalizeAmount(invertSign: boolean)` flag argument.
155	- **RF-12** — name the magic-number matching defaults.
156	- **RF-13** — fix `PDFExportService.shouldEnablePDFExport` (Inappropriate Static + state object).
157	> Each RF is production code: use the existing tests as the safety net, teeth-prove any test you add,
158	> and follow the codebase-design "deep module" vocabulary if reshaping an interface.
159	
160	### 2.C Small test-coverage follow-ups (backlog → "Test-coverage backlog", low priority)
161	Expenses CSV export **filename** branching; `getSignedReceiptUrl()` null/error/expiry edge cases;
162	`PDFExportService` US-Letter dims (612×792) + per-category row-number restart; Resend handler orchestration
163	(blocked on the handler-testability PRD).
164	
165	### 2.D Lint hygiene — get `npm run lint` green (do last; NEW, in backlog under Engineering)
166	`npm run lint` = `prettier --check . && eslint .`. The **Prettier step currently FAILS** on ~62
167	pre-existing files (`llm_history/*.md`, `vite.config.ts`, `supabase/functions/*`, `CategoryFilter.svelte`,
168	`admin/resize-images/+page.svelte`, `ExchangeRateService.spec.ts`, `__tests__/*.test.ts`). Because of the
169	`&&`, **ESLint never runs repo-wide**, so unknown ESLint debt lurks in untouched files. We only find it
170	incidentally when touching a file (found + fixed: `CategoryService.spec.ts` 24 `any`, `dateValidation.spec.ts`
171	1 `as any`). Action: (1) add `llm_history/` to `.prettierignore` (it's an archive) and format the rest of
172	the real source once (touched-file scoped, not blindly); (2) run `eslint .` project-wide and triage/fix.
173	**Until this is done, "0 warnings" only means svelte-check + eslint-on-touched-files, not the full gate.**
174	Rationale for going last: a repo-wide format/lint pass is easiest once the code churn above (test
175	conversions + RF work) has settled, so you format/triage once instead of re-touching the same files.
176	
177	---
178	
179	## 3. PROCESS RULES (non-negotiable — from CLAUDE.md + project memory)
180	- **Never `git commit`.** Stage/write/test only; humans commit.
181	- **Never `npm run format` / `prettier --write .`** (repo-wide). Format only touched files:
182	  `npx prettier --write <files>` — and **run `npx prettier --check <files>` as the final gate**
183	  (this session's miss: `--write` was run before later edits, so 2 files drifted; `--check` catches it).
184	- **When you touch a file, clear its pre-existing lint/type warnings too** (not just note them).
185	- **No `any` even in tests** — typed mocks / `MockQueryBuilder` / `Partial` / `as unknown as X`;
186	  `as any` is last-resort with a stated reason.
187	- **No Mistral/OCR API calls in unit tests** — assert prompt constants, keep logic pure, mock `fetch`.
188	- **Prove every test against an oracle or a real induced break.** For a *split*, oracle = identical
189	  passing test count before/after. For a *new behavior test*, break the production line it guards, watch
190	  it go red, then revert. For an *extract/characterization*, run the original code verbatim as oracle.
191	- **Playwright/browser tests are seam-only** where a unit test can own correctness; unit tests own logic.
192	- New refactoring ideas start as one-liners in `docs/product-backlog.md`, promoted to a detailed
193	  `refactoring-backlog.md` entry only when work starts.
194	- `.env` is a 1Password FIFO — don't `rm`/overwrite it; tooling injects fake `PUBLIC_` env so check/build run.
195	
196	---
197	
198	## 4. LESSONS LEARNED THIS EPIC (avoid re-hitting)
199	- **zsh `for x in "a b c"; set -- $x` word-splitting is unreliable here** — it once created junk files
200	  named with literal line numbers and deleted a source file mid-loop (recovered via `git checkout`). Use
201	  **explicit per-file commands** for `sed` line-range extraction, not a loop.
202	- **`git checkout -- <file>`** is the clean way to restore an accidentally-mangled production file after an
203	  induced-break test (this session: a manual BOM revert swapped `'﻿'` for a literal BOM char).
204	- **Splitting a file with a hoisted `vi.mock` preamble** duplicates that preamble per file (hoisting can't
205	  be shared via import). Splitting a file whose mock is a plain **factory** can extract the factory to a
206	  shared `*TestHelpers.ts` (see `expenseServiceTestHelpers.ts`).
207	- **Introspection→behavior conversions surface real bugs-in-tests**: e.g. the old `layout-navigation` spec
208	  claimed the Profile link is "visible to all users" via a 200-char proximity heuristic — it's actually

# Handoff — remaining refactoring, tidy-up & test improvements

**Date:** 2026-07-09
**Scope:** Everything still open after the test-suite-cleanup epic, plus full docs for the
**new route/layout render-test system** the next agent will build on.

> Scratch/local, under `.scratch/` (gitignored). The running blow-by-blow log of the
> completed epic is in `handoff-test-suite-cleanup.md`; **this** doc is the forward-looking
> summary. Read `CLAUDE.md` (repo root) and `docs/product-backlog.md` first.

---

## 0. Status snapshot (as of this handoff)

- **All green:** `npm run check` (svelte-check, whole project) = **0 errors / 0 warnings**;
  full unit suite ≈ **1375 passed / 8 skipped**; ESLint clean on every file touched this epic.
- **Uncommitted:** only 2 Prettier fixes to `ExpenseService.{getExpenses,categoryAssignment}.spec.ts`.
  Humans commit — do **not** `git commit`.
- **Test count dropped over the epic (1671 → ~1375) on purpose:** hollow tests (source-introspection,
  reimplemented-logic, RED-phase scaffolding, tautologies) were replaced by fewer, stronger behavior
  tests. Lower count = higher signal.

### What the epic already finished (don't redo)
- **§2a** — all 10 `readFileSync`-their-own-source introspection specs → real behavior tests or deleted.
- **§2b** — split 3 oversized specs (`ExpenseService`, `expenses-page-filters`, `ReceiptService`);
  `ReceiptService.split.spec.ts` left intact (single concern).
- **§2c** — routed inline row-building through builders where it was a real duplicate.
- **Reimplemented-logic** — the `expenses-filters.*` specs (tested their own inline `.filter()` copies)
  → deleted/redirected to real owners (`sharedDateFilter.spec`, `dateValidation.spec`, render tests).
- **Unimplemented/placeholder** — `CategoryService.spec.ts` stale TDD RED-phase scaffolding stripped
  (+ typed mock, 24 `any`→0); `CSVExportService` two empty `it.skip` browser placeholders → real
  browser tests in `CSVExportService.svelte.spec.ts`.
- **Foreign-currency amount cell** — render tests on both pages; both math sites teeth-proven.

---

## 1. THE ROUTE/LAYOUT RENDER-TEST SYSTEM (new — read before writing any page/component test)

**Why it exists:** SvelteKit route/layout components import `$app/stores`, `$app/navigation`,
`$app/paths`, and `$lib/supabaseClient` (a module-level Supabase singleton created at import → throws /
hits the network in a test). They also `new SomeService(supabase)` and load data on mount. The harness
mocks those boundaries so a **real** `+layout.svelte` / `+page.svelte` / component renders in the browser.

### 1.1 Files
- `src/lib/tests/harness/appMocks.ts` — the controllable mocks + service stubs (the heart of the system).
- `src/lib/tests/harness/LayoutHarness.svelte` — wraps the real `+layout.svelte` with a marker child so
  the auth-gate ("does page content render?") is assertable.
- Existing render specs to copy from: `layout-render.svelte.spec.ts`, `expenses-page.svelte.spec.ts`,
  `receipts-page.svelte.spec.ts`, `expenses-page-receipt-modal.svelte.spec.ts`, `profile-page.svelte.spec.ts`,
  `receipt-image-click.svelte.spec.ts`, `ReceiptEditModal.svelte.spec.ts`, `CSVExportService.svelte.spec.ts`.
  Component-level examples: `DataTable.svelte.spec.ts`, `FilteredEmptyState.svelte.spec.ts`.

### 1.2 HARD naming/env rule
Render tests run in the **`client`** (Playwright/browser) vitest project, whose include glob is
`src/**/*.svelte.{test,spec}.{js,ts}`. **The file MUST be named `*.svelte.spec.ts`** (even if it renders
no Svelte component — e.g. `CSVExportService.svelte.spec.ts` just needs the DOM). A plain `*.spec.ts`
runs in the node `server` project (no DOM) and will fail. Projects are configured in `vite.config.ts`.

### 1.3 Controllable API (all exported from `harness/appMocks.ts`)
- `pageStore` — the `$app/stores` `page` store; `setRoute(pathname, search?)` points it at a URL.
- `setSession(session | null)` + `fakeSession(userId?)` — drive auth. `fakeSession()` carries
  `user.id/email/created_at`. `setSessionPending()` makes `getSession()` hang (to assert a Loading state).
- `supabaseMock` — auth (`getSession`/`getUser`/`onAuthStateChange`/`signOut`) + a `from()` that backs the
  `profiles` table via `setProfile(row | null)` / `makeProfile(overrides)` (null → PGRST116 "no rows").
- Service stubs (mock the module, drive the data): `ReceiptServiceStub` + `setReceipts(rows)`;
  `ExpenseServiceStub` + `setExpenses(rows)`; `CategoryServiceStub` + `setCategories(rows)`.
- `resetHarness()` — clears everything; call in `beforeEach`.

### 1.4 Skeleton of a new page render test
```ts
import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import { render } from 'vitest-browser-svelte';
import { makeExpense } from './builders/rowBuilders';
import { pageStore, supabaseMock, ExpenseServiceStub, CategoryServiceStub, ReceiptServiceStub,
         setExpenses, setSession, fakeSession, resetHarness } from './harness/appMocks';

// vi.mock is hoisted per-file — these MUST be in each spec (can't be shared via import).
vi.mock('$app/stores', () => ({ page: pageStore }));
vi.mock('$lib/supabaseClient', () => ({ supabase: supabaseMock }));
vi.mock('$app/navigation', () => ({ goto: () => {}, replaceState: () => {} }));
vi.mock('$app/paths', () => ({ resolve: (p: string) => p }));
vi.mock('$lib/utils/signedUrl', () => ({ getSignedReceiptUrls: async () => ({}), getSignedReceiptUrl: async () => null }));
vi.mock('$lib/utils/familyUtils', () => ({ getDefaultFamilyId: async () => 'family-1' })); // expenses page needs a family id
vi.mock('$lib/services/ExpenseService', () => ({ ExpenseService: ExpenseServiceStub }));
vi.mock('$lib/services/CategoryService', () => ({ CategoryService: CategoryServiceStub }));
vi.mock('$lib/services/ReceiptService', () => ({ ReceiptService: ReceiptServiceStub }));

import ExpensesPage from '../../routes/expenses/+page.svelte';

describe('...', () => {
  beforeEach(resetHarness);
  it('...', async () => {
    setSession(fakeSession());
    setExpenses([makeExpense({ /* ... */ })]);
    const screen = render(ExpensesPage);
    await expect.element(screen.getByText('...')).toBeVisible();
  });
});
```
Notes: the **receipts** page short-circuits category loading if `getDefaultFamilyId` returns `null`
(simpler); the **expenses** page renders a "No family" error unless it returns a real id. Check each
page's `onMount` for which services/utils it actually calls and stub only those.

### 1.5 Locator gotchas (these cost real time — learn them)
- `getByText` is **substring + case-insensitive** (Playwright). Avoid overlapping fixtures
  ("Categorized" ⊂ "Uncategorized"); use distinct merchant names ('Alpha Store'/'Beta Store') or `{ exact: true }`.
- **DataTable** only marks **sortable** headers `role="columnheader"`; non-sortable headers are plain `<th>`
  (role `cell`). Assert non-sortable columns by their cell content, not `getByRole('columnheader')`.
- Filter toggles / dropdown options can collide with row **category-cell** buttons of the same text.
  The FilterPanel renders **above** the table, so `.first()` targets the filter control. The expenses
  Category dropdown is `hidden`-class-toggled: click the "Category" button first, then `.first()` the option.
- **BOM / binary asserts:** `Blob.text()` strips a leading UTF-8 BOM per spec — assert raw bytes
  (`new Uint8Array(await blob.arrayBuffer())` → `EF BB BF`) instead of `text.startsWith('﻿')`.
- Cross-test async bleed: the heavy pages have long async mount chains; keep fixtures per-test and reset in
  `beforeEach`. If a "count/summary" assertion flakes, it's usually a locator collision, not the harness.

### 1.6 What it does NOT cover (still seam-only)
`#{#ath1c}` (protected pages must not self-redirect to `/login`) stays a **source** check in
`auth-route-guard.spec.ts` — it's an absence-of-anti-pattern across 4 page files, orthogonal to render.
Fine to leave; convert only if you build per-page unauthenticated-render coverage.

---

## 2. REMAINING WORK

### 2.A Remaining test-quality items (the "second frontier")
- **Audit for more reimplemented-logic specs.** The `expenses-filters.*` set was the one I'd concretely
  identified; I did **not** exhaustively sweep. Heuristic: `grep -rn "function \(filter\|calculate\|parse\|generate\)" src --include="*.spec.ts"` — spec-local helpers that then assert their **own** output are hollow.
  Convert each to its real owner (util spec or a render test), like §-reimplemented-logic did.
- **Hollow "has-method" checks (~7, low value).** `expect(typeof service.X).toBe('function')` in
  `ExpenseService.vendorRules/categoryAssignment/getExpenses`, `ReceiptService.split/bulk`,
  `CategoryDropdown.spec`. A method existing is guaranteed by the class + TS. Optional: delete each
  (one per suite) — churn > benefit, so left as-is.
- **`family-category-visibility.spec.ts` — env-gated integration.** Gated by
  `describeIf(SUPABASE_URL && SERVICE_KEY)` → **never runs in CI** (no service role key; no seed harness
  exists). Real assertions, just never executed. Decision needed: keep as a real-DB integration suite
  (leave), or delete if integration tests will never run. Left intact for now.
- **`ReceiptService.split.spec.ts` (1024 lines) — deliberately NOT split.** Single cohesive concern
  (receipt-split) with a shared module-level `beforeEach`; concern-splitting adds duplication for no gain.
- **`auth-route-guard.spec.ts`** — trimmed to just the `#{#ath1c}` residual source guard (see §1.6).
- **Weak-test trap reminder (project memory):** some specs reimplement logic inline or grep source —
  don't over-trust green. `ReceiptImageViewer.spec.ts` was flagged historically as an example.

### 2.B Production refactoring backlog (RF-04 → RF-13, all OPEN)
Full detail in `docs/refactoring-backlog.md` (reference doc — don't grow a parallel list). RF-01–03 done;
RF-D1/D2 deferred. Surface as one-liners in `docs/product-backlog.md` (single working list). Open:
- **RF-04** — de-duplicate `findPotentialMatches` / `findPotentialMatchesForTransaction` copy-paste pair.
- **RF-05** — break up long methods in the service layer.
- **RF-06** — bundle matching tolerances (Long Parameter List / Data Clump) into one object *(correctness-adjacent)*.
- **RF-07** — reconcile the singleton-vs-DI split across services.
- **RF-08** — replace `any` with precise types where one already exists *(partly chipped at: CategoryService/dateValidation specs)*.
- **RF-09** — collapse the three inconsistent ways to resolve a row's Category into one.
- **RF-10** — move UI display massaging out of `ReconciliationService` (Feature Envy).
- **RF-11** — replace the `normalizeAmount(invertSign: boolean)` flag argument.
- **RF-12** — name the magic-number matching defaults.
- **RF-13** — fix `PDFExportService.shouldEnablePDFExport` (Inappropriate Static + state object).
> Each RF is production code: use the existing tests as the safety net, teeth-prove any test you add,
> and follow the codebase-design "deep module" vocabulary if reshaping an interface.

### 2.C Small test-coverage follow-ups (backlog → "Test-coverage backlog", low priority)
Expenses CSV export **filename** branching; `getSignedReceiptUrl()` null/error/expiry edge cases;
`PDFExportService` US-Letter dims (612×792) + per-category row-number restart; Resend handler orchestration
(blocked on the handler-testability PRD).

### 2.D Lint hygiene — get `npm run lint` green (do last; NEW, in backlog under Engineering)
`npm run lint` = `prettier --check . && eslint .`. The **Prettier step currently FAILS** on ~62
pre-existing files (`llm_history/*.md`, `vite.config.ts`, `supabase/functions/*`, `CategoryFilter.svelte`,
`admin/resize-images/+page.svelte`, `ExchangeRateService.spec.ts`, `__tests__/*.test.ts`). Because of the
`&&`, **ESLint never runs repo-wide**, so unknown ESLint debt lurks in untouched files. We only find it
incidentally when touching a file (found + fixed: `CategoryService.spec.ts` 24 `any`, `dateValidation.spec.ts`
1 `as any`). Action: (1) add `llm_history/` to `.prettierignore` (it's an archive) and format the rest of
the real source once (touched-file scoped, not blindly); (2) run `eslint .` project-wide and triage/fix.
**Until this is done, "0 warnings" only means svelte-check + eslint-on-touched-files, not the full gate.**
Rationale for going last: a repo-wide format/lint pass is easiest once the code churn above (test
conversions + RF work) has settled, so you format/triage once instead of re-touching the same files.

---

## 3. PROCESS RULES (non-negotiable — from CLAUDE.md + project memory)
- **Never `git commit`.** Stage/write/test only; humans commit.
- **Never `npm run format` / `prettier --write .`** (repo-wide). Format only touched files:
  `npx prettier --write <files>` — and **run `npx prettier --check <files>` as the final gate**
  (this session's miss: `--write` was run before later edits, so 2 files drifted; `--check` catches it).
- **When you touch a file, clear its pre-existing lint/type warnings too** (not just note them).
- **No `any` even in tests** — typed mocks / `MockQueryBuilder` / `Partial` / `as unknown as X`;
  `as any` is last-resort with a stated reason.
- **No Mistral/OCR API calls in unit tests** — assert prompt constants, keep logic pure, mock `fetch`.
- **Prove every test against an oracle or a real induced break.** For a *split*, oracle = identical
  passing test count before/after. For a *new behavior test*, break the production line it guards, watch
  it go red, then revert. For an *extract/characterization*, run the original code verbatim as oracle.
- **Playwright/browser tests are seam-only** where a unit test can own correctness; unit tests own logic.
- New refactoring ideas start as one-liners in `docs/product-backlog.md`, promoted to a detailed
  `refactoring-backlog.md` entry only when work starts.
- `.env` is a 1Password FIFO — don't `rm`/overwrite it; tooling injects fake `PUBLIC_` env so check/build run.

---

## 4. LESSONS LEARNED THIS EPIC (avoid re-hitting)
- **zsh `for x in "a b c"; set -- $x` word-splitting is unreliable here** — it once created junk files
  named with literal line numbers and deleted a source file mid-loop (recovered via `git checkout`). Use
  **explicit per-file commands** for `sed` line-range extraction, not a loop.
- **`git checkout -- <file>`** is the clean way to restore an accidentally-mangled production file after an
  induced-break test (this session: a manual BOM revert swapped `'﻿'` for a literal BOM char).
- **Splitting a file with a hoisted `vi.mock` preamble** duplicates that preamble per file (hoisting can't
  be shared via import). Splitting a file whose mock is a plain **factory** can extract the factory to a
  shared `*TestHelpers.ts` (see `expenseServiceTestHelpers.ts`).
- **Introspection→behavior conversions surface real bugs-in-tests**: e.g. the old `layout-navigation` spec
  claimed the Profile link is "visible to all users" via a 200-char proximity heuristic — it's actually
  inside `{#if $session}` and hidden when signed out. Assert the truth, and say so.

---

## 5. Suggested skills for the next agent
`tdd` (red-green discipline), `code-review` (sanity-check each converted spec covers behavior),
`codebase-design` (deep-module vocab before reshaping an interface for an RF), `verify` (drive a real
flow end-to-end for anything touching runtime).

Confirmed: clicking "Create new category…" **closes the whole dropdown** instead of showing the form. This is a real component bug the hollow test hid: Svelte 5 flushes state synchronously after the delegated click handler, so the create button detaches from the DOM before the event bubbles to the document-level click-outside listener — which then sees a detached target, treats it as an "outside" click, and closes the menu.

Let me clean up the diagnostic and confirm the root cause, then fix the component.

content.content:
=== Test-coverage backlog section ===
### Test-coverage backlog

Optional, low-priority follow-ups — pure test coverage, no behaviour change.

- **Expenses CSV export filename.** Extract + unit-test the Expenses-page CSV export filename branching (`expenses_<from>_to_<to>.csv` etc.), currently inline and untested in `src/routes/expenses/+page.svelte`.
- **`getSignedReceiptUrl()` edge cases.** Add direct unit tests for null/empty-path → null (no API call) and storage-error → null (no throw), and assert the 300s OCR signed-URL expiry; today only the batch `collectSignedUrls` variant is tested.
- **PDF export dimensions & row numbering.** Add `PDFExportService` assertions for US-Letter page dimensions (612×792) and the per-category row-number restart at 1, currently unasserted.
- **Resend handler orchestration.** The process-all-attachments loop and body-text fallback (eaf4a/eaf5a) stay unit-untestable until the handler is refactored to be importable — tracked in [PRD — Make the Resend webhook handler testable](prd-resend-handler-testability.md).

### Test-suite cleanup (quality only — no production-behavior change)

Tidy the `*.spec.ts` suites. Each item is proven against an oracle or a real induced
failure, one spec file per PR-sized unit — see `.scratch/handoff-test-suite-cleanup.md`.

- **Convert source-introspection specs → behavior tests. ✅ DONE.** All 10 `readFileSync`-their-own-source specs were converted to real behavior tests (render via the `*.svelte.spec.ts` harness or exercise the service/util directly) or deleted as redundant. The only surviving source check is `auth-route-guard.spec.ts`'s `#{#ath1c}` no-per-page-redirect guard, kept deliberately (see the render-harness item below). Converting them surfaced a real false-positive bug-in-a-test (Profile link "visible to all users") and confirmed several bodies of logic were already covered by util/service specs.
- **Split oversized service specs. ✅ DONE (3 of 4; the 4th is single-concern).** Each split preserved the exact test set (oracle: identical passing count before/after).
  - `ExpenseService.spec.ts` (2165) → `ExpenseService.{getExpenses,categoryAssignment,vendorRules,matchStatus}.spec.ts` + shared `expenseServiceTestHelpers.ts` (105 tests).
  - `expenses-page-filters.spec.ts` (1404) → `expenses-filters.{uncategorized,categoryAnalytics,dateFilter,filterCount}.spec.ts` + shared `builders/expenseFilterFixtures.ts` (85 tests). _(These four were subsequently deleted/converted — the tests turned out to be reimplemented-logic; see the reimplemented-logic bullet below.)_
  - `ReceiptService.spec.ts` (1276) → `ReceiptService.{suspiciousDate,autoCategory,uploadMeta}.spec.ts` (44 tests). The `vi.mock` preamble is replicated per file (hoisting can't be shared via import).
  - `ReceiptService.split.spec.ts` (1024) — **left intact**: it is a single cohesive concern (the receipt-split feature) with a shared module-level `beforeEach`; concern-splitting a single-concern spec adds duplication for little gain.
- **Route inline row-building through the builders. ✅ DONE (small footprint).** `duplicateDetection.spec.ts`'s local `createReceipt` factory now delegates to `makeReceiptRow` (dropping an `as ReceiptRow` cast; oracle: 19 tests unchanged). Audit finding: most other "inline rows" are NOT builder candidates — they're partial Supabase query-result shapes (`ExpenseService.matchStatus`, `ReceiptService.autoCategory/uploadMeta` — the DB returns a subset of columns, not a full `ReceiptRow`), deliberate single-field minimal stubs (`reconciliationRowEdit.spec.ts`), or dead code (`duplicateHelpers.spec.ts`'s unused `createReceipt`). Forcing the builder into those would mis-shape the mock or add noise.
- **Foreign-currency amount cell render test. ✅ DONE.** The inline `total_amount * exchange_rate_to_cad` CAD-estimate math in the `amountCell` snippets of both `expenses/+page.svelte` and `receipts/+page.svelte` now has behavior coverage on the render harness: `expenses-page.svelte.spec.ts` and `receipts-page.svelte.spec.ts` render a foreign-currency (EUR, rate 1.53) row and assert `€45.00 (≈$68.85)`, plus a null-rate case that shows no estimate. Both production math sites were teeth-proven (turning `*` into `+` broke the estimate). No production extraction was needed after all — the harness made it directly testable.
- **Convert reimplemented-logic specs → real behavior/util tests. ✅ DONE.** The four `expenses-filters.*` specs tested locally-defined copies of the page's filter/analytics logic (`filterByCategory`, `calculateSpendingSummary`, `filterExpensesByURLDates`, …) — green whether or not the real code works. Resolved by routing each concern to its real owner: date-filter URL parse/generate/filter were **redundant** with `sharedDateFilter.spec.ts` (49 real tests) → deleted; the genuine `getValidDate` tests (its only coverage) **moved** to `dateValidation.spec.ts`; the uncategorized and category filters became **render tests** on the expenses page (`expenses-page.svelte.spec.ts` — toggle the Uncategorized button / pick a category, assert the visible rows + filtered count, both teeth-proven); sorting is owned by `DataTable.svelte.spec.ts`; the spending-summary reimplementation guarded **unbuilt UI** (no summary panel is rendered) → deleted. Net: ~82 hollow reimplementation tests replaced by real coverage. Also fixed a pre-existing `as any` in `dateValidation.spec.ts`.
- **Remove/implement unimplemented & placeholder tests. ✅ DONE (main finds).** (a) `CategoryService.spec.ts` was stale TDD **RED-phase scaffolding** — a dynamic `import()` in try/catch with a dead `if (!CategoryService) { expect.fail('not implemented yet'); return; }` guard in all 28 tests, even though the service has long existed. Stripped the scaffolding → static typed import; also replaced the whole `any`-typed mock with a typed `MockQueryBuilder` (24 `any`s → 0). 28 tests unchanged. (b) `CSVExportService.spec.ts`'s two empty `it.skip('… browser only')` placeholders → **implemented for real** in `CSVExportService.svelte.spec.ts` (client project): asserts the anchor download fires and — via raw-bytes (`EF BB BF`, since `Blob.text()` strips a leading BOM) — that the UTF-8 BOM is present for Excel. Teeth-proven. Non-finds: `ReceiptService.bulk.spec.ts`'s `expect.fail` are legit "should have thrown" guards. Still open (minor/intentional): `family-category-visibility.spec.ts` is an integration suite gated by `describeIf(SUPABASE_URL && SERVICE_KEY)` — never runs in CI (no service key); it's a valid real-DB pattern, left as-is. A handful of hollow `expect(typeof service.X).toBe('function')` "has-method" checks remain, scattered one-per-suite — low value, not removed.
- **Route/layout render harness — BUILT & USED.** `src/lib/tests/harness/appMocks.ts` (+ `LayoutHarness.svelte`) mocks the SvelteKit + Supabase module boundaries and exposes controllable state: `setRoute`/`setSession`/`setSessionPending`, `setReceipts`/`setExpenses`/`setCategories`/`setProfile`, and `ReceiptServiceStub`/`ExpenseServiceStub`/`CategoryServiceStub`. It renders real `+layout.svelte` / `+page.svelte` / components in the `client` project. Every page/layout/component introspection spec was converted on it: `layout-render.svelte.spec.ts` (layout gate + nav, was auth-route-guard + layout-navigation), `receipt-image-click.svelte.spec.ts`, `expenses-page.svelte.spec.ts`, `receipts-page.svelte.spec.ts` (filter wiring), `expenses-page-receipt-modal.svelte.spec.ts` (row → modal), `profile-page.svelte.spec.ts`, and `ReceiptEditModal.svelte.spec.ts` (component: validation/discard/notice/category/filename). Each was proven with an induced production break. The `#{#ath1c}` no-per-page-redirect guard remains a source check in `auth-route-guard.spec.ts` (a page-level absence-of-anti-pattern, orthogonal to the layout render).

## Refactoring

Open items only — full detail in [Refactoring backlog](refactoring-backlog.md).
(RF-01–03 are done; RF-D1/D2 are deferred pending a decision.)

- **[RF-04](refactoring-backlog.md#rf-04--findpotentialmatches-vs-findpotentialmatchesfortransaction-are-a-copy-paste-pair)** — De-duplicate the `findPotentialMatches` / `findPotentialMatchesForTransaction` copy-paste pair.
- **[RF-05](refactoring-backlog.md#rf-05--long-methods-in-the-service-layer)** — Break up the long methods in the service layer.
- **[RF-06](refactoring-backlog.md#rf-06--matching-tolerances-are-a-long-parameter-list--data-clump)** — Bundle the matching tolerances (Long Parameter List / Data Clump) into one object _(correctness-adjacent)_.
- **[RF-07](refactoring-backlog.md#rf-07--singleton-vs-dependency-injection-split-across-services)** — Reconcile the singleton-vs-dependency-injection split across services.
- **[RF-08](refactoring-backlog.md#rf-08--any-where-a-precise-type-exists)** — Replace `any` with precise types where one already exists.
- **[RF-09](refactoring-backlog.md#rf-09--three-inconsistent-ways-to-resolve-a-rows-category)** — Collapse the three inconsistent ways to resolve a row's Category into one.
- **[RF-10](refactoring-backlog.md#rf-10--reconciliationservice-does-ui-display-massaging)** — Move UI display massaging out of `ReconciliationService` (Feature Envy).
- **[RF-11](refactoring-backlog.md#rf-11--normalizeamountinvertsign-boolean-flag-argument)** — Replace the `normalizeAmount(invertSign: boolean)` flag argument.
- **[RF-12](refactoring-backlog.md#rf-12--magic-number-matching-defaults)** — Name the magic-number matching defaults.

content.content:
50	  - `ReceiptService.split.spec.ts` (1024) — **left intact**: it is a single cohesive concern (the receipt-split feature) with a shared module-level `beforeEach`; concern-splitting a single-concern spec adds duplication for little gain.
51	- **Route inline row-building through the builders. ✅ DONE (small footprint).** `duplicateDetection.spec.ts`'s local `createReceipt` factory now delegates to `makeReceiptRow` (dropping an `as ReceiptRow` cast; oracle: 19 tests unchanged). Audit finding: most other "inline rows" are NOT builder candidates — they're partial Supabase query-result shapes (`ExpenseService.matchStatus`, `ReceiptService.autoCategory/uploadMeta` — the DB returns a subset of columns, not a full `ReceiptRow`), deliberate single-field minimal stubs (`reconciliationRowEdit.spec.ts`), or dead code (`duplicateHelpers.spec.ts`'s unused `createReceipt`). Forcing the builder into those would mis-shape the mock or add noise.
52	- **Foreign-currency amount cell render test. ✅ DONE.** The inline `total_amount * exchange_rate_to_cad` CAD-estimate math in the `amountCell` snippets of both `expenses/+page.svelte` and `receipts/+page.svelte` now has behavior coverage on the render harness: `expenses-page.svelte.spec.ts` and `receipts-page.svelte.spec.ts` render a foreign-currency (EUR, rate 1.53) row and assert `€45.00 (≈$68.85)`, plus a null-rate case that shows no estimate. Both production math sites were teeth-proven (turning `*` into `+` broke the estimate). No production extraction was needed after all — the harness made it directly testable.
53	- **Convert reimplemented-logic specs → real behavior/util tests. ✅ DONE.** The four `expenses-filters.*` specs tested locally-defined copies of the page's filter/analytics logic (`filterByCategory`, `calculateSpendingSummary`, `filterExpensesByURLDates`, …) — green whether or not the real code works. Resolved by routing each concern to its real owner: date-filter URL parse/generate/filter were **redundant** with `sharedDateFilter.spec.ts` (49 real tests) → deleted; the genuine `getValidDate` tests (its only coverage) **moved** to `dateValidation.spec.ts`; the uncategorized and category filters became **render tests** on the expenses page (`expenses-page.svelte.spec.ts` — toggle the Uncategorized button / pick a category, assert the visible rows + filtered count, both teeth-proven); sorting is owned by `DataTable.svelte.spec.ts`; the spending-summary reimplementation guarded **unbuilt UI** (no summary panel is rendered) → deleted. Net: ~82 hollow reimplementation tests replaced by real coverage. Also fixed a pre-existing `as any` in `dateValidation.spec.ts`.
54	- **Remove/implement unimplemented & placeholder tests. ✅ DONE (main finds).** (a) `CategoryService.spec.ts` was stale TDD **RED-phase scaffolding** — a dynamic `import()` in try/catch with a dead `if (!CategoryService) { expect.fail('not implemented yet'); return; }` guard in all 28 tests, even though the service has long existed. Stripped the scaffolding → static typed import; also replaced the whole `any`-typed mock with a typed `MockQueryBuilder` (24 `any`s → 0). 28 tests unchanged. (b) `CSVExportService.spec.ts`'s two empty `it.skip('… browser only')` placeholders → **implemented for real** in `CSVExportService.svelte.spec.ts` (client project): asserts the anchor download fires and — via raw-bytes (`EF BB BF`, since `Blob.text()` strips a leading BOM) — that the UTF-8 BOM is present for Excel. Teeth-proven. Non-finds: `ReceiptService.bulk.spec.ts`'s `expect.fail` are legit "should have thrown" guards. Still open (minor/intentional): `family-category-visibility.spec.ts` is an integration suite gated by `describeIf(SUPABASE_URL && SERVICE_KEY)` — never runs in CI (no service key); it's a valid real-DB pattern, left as-is. A handful of hollow `expect(typeof service.X).toBe('function')` "has-method" checks remain, scattered one-per-suite — low value, not removed.
55	- **Route/layout render harness — BUILT & USED.** `src/lib/tests/harness/appMocks.ts` (+ `LayoutHarness.svelte`) mocks the SvelteKit + Supabase module boundaries and exposes controllable state: `setRoute`/`setSession`/`setSessionPending`, `setReceipts`/`setExpenses`/`setCategories`/`setProfile`, and `ReceiptServiceStub`/`ExpenseServiceStub`/`CategoryServiceStub`. It renders real `+layout.svelte` / `+page.svelte` / components in the `client` project. Every page/layout/component introspection spec was converted on it: `layout-render.svelte.spec.ts` (layout gate + nav, was auth-route-guard + layout-navigation), `receipt-image-click.svelte.spec.ts`, `expenses-page.svelte.spec.ts`, `receipts-page.svelte.spec.ts` (filter wiring), `expenses-page-receipt-modal.svelte.spec.ts` (row → modal), `profile-page.svelte.spec.ts`, and `ReceiptEditModal.svelte.spec.ts` (component: validation/discard/notice/category/filename). Each was proven with an induced production break. The `#{#ath1c}` no-per-page-redirect guard remains a source check in `auth-route-guard.spec.ts` (a page-level absence-of-anti-pattern, orthogonal to the layout render).
56	
57	## Refactoring
58	
59	Open items only — full detail in [Refactoring backlog](refactoring-backlog.md).

This is an environment/config issue, not a code bug — and unrelated to my test changes.

## What's happening

`src/lib/supabaseClient.ts:26` creates the Supabase client at **module import time** and throws if `PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` / `PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` are missing. Your `.env` is the **1Password FIFO** (`prw-------` named pipe, 0 bytes), so it only yields values when the process runs under 1Password. Plain `npm run dev` (`vite dev`) injects nothing → the vars are empty → 500 on every route.

That's why `npm run check`/`prepare` work but `dev` doesn't: those scripts hard-code fake `PUBLIC_*` values inline; `dev` and `build` don't.

## How to run it

**Real backend (intended path):** launch dev through 1Password so the FIFO is populated — e.g.
```
op run -- npm run dev
```
(exact form depends on how you normally source it; it needs your 1Password session, so I can't run it for you).

**Without 1Password (boots the UI; Supabase calls have no real backend):** inject the same fake env the other scripts use —
```
PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=http://localhost:54321 PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=test-anon-key MISTRAL_API_KEY=test npm run dev
```
I verified this path: Vite booted cleanly on a spare port with no errors and the env-throw 500 gone. (I couldn't curl the routes — the sandbox blocks outbound HTTP — but the module-level throw is what caused the 500, and it no longer fires once the vars are set.)

I did **not** touch `.env`, the `dev` script, or `supabaseClient.ts` — adding fake env to `dev` would break real local dev against your Supabase, so that's a one-off command, not a code change. If you'd like, I can add a separate `dev:fake`/`dev:offline` script that injects the placeholder env, leaving `dev` pointed at the real backend.

Done. `package.json` now runs dev through 1Password:

```json
"dev": "op run --env-file=.env -- vite dev",
```

`op run` reads the `.env` FIFO, resolves its secret references, and injects them into the process environment so `$env/static/public` (`PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` / `PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`) is populated. I verified it: `npm run dev` now boots Vite cleanly with no auth prompt and no more "Supabase environment variables are not set" 500.

Notes:
- It relies on an active 1Password session; if `op` isn't signed in, it'll prompt/fail rather than serve — that's expected for the real-backend path you asked for.
- I only changed `dev`. I left `build`/`preview` alone since the e2e flow builds with injected fake env (per project tooling) and wrapping those in `op run` could break it. If you want them on 1Password too, say the word.
- I did not touch the `.env` FIFO itself.

See [PRD — Make the Resend webhook handler testable](prd-resend-handler-testability.md).

Unit tests only cover logic, not real gestures — manually confirm wheel-zoom, drag-to-pan, pinch-zoom, and keyboard/screen-reader access still work.
29	- **Run ESLint over the whole project (get `npm run lint` green).** `npm run lint` is `prettier --check . && eslint .` — and the Prettier step currently **fails** on ~62 pre-existing files (`llm_history/*.md`, `vite.config.ts`, `supabase/functions/*`, `CategoryFilter.svelte`, `admin/resize-images/+page.svelte`, `ExchangeRateService.spec.ts`, `__tests__/*.test.ts`). Great question — since `npm run dev` now works, focus your manual testing on the **three production changes I made this session** (everything else was test-only and has no runtime surface). Ranked by risk:

## 1. Category dropdown — the real behavior fix (highest priority)
I changed `CategoryDropdown.svelte`'s click-outside handler to fix a bug where clicking **"Create new category…"** closed the whole dropdown instead of opening the inline form. This component appears in **4 places**, so test it in each:

- **Expenses page** (category cell), **Receipts page**, **Reconciliation page**, and the **Receipt edit modal**.

In at least one (ideally each), click a category cell to open the dropdown and confirm:
- ✅ **"Create new category…" now reveals the inline name/color form** (this was the bug — previously the dropdown just closed).
- Type a name → **Create** adds & selects it; empty name → "Category name required"; duplicate → "Category already exists".
- Picking an existing category still selects it and closes the menu.
- Typing in the **search box filters** the list.
- **Click outside** still closes it; **Escape** still closes it.

> Note: two *separate, pre-existing* known issues are on the backlog — "Category dropdown clipped" (out of view in the editor) and "Category edit scrolls to top." Those are **not** what I changed; don't conflate them with this fix.

## 2. Transactions page — Filters panel (`/transactions`)
I moved the filter logic into `transactionFilters.ts`; behavior should be **identical**. Sanity-check the Filters panel:
- Filter by **date range**, **vendor** substring, **amount min/max**, and **credit/bank type** — individually and **combined**.
- When filters hide everything, the **"filters are hiding rows" empty state** + **Clear filters** appears and works.

## 3. Expenses page — CSV export filename (`/expenses`)
I moved the filename branching into `CSVExportService.expenseExportFilename()`. Export CSV under different filters and check the **downloaded filename**:
- Date range → `expenses_<from>_to_<to>.csv`; start-only → `expenses_from_<from>.csv`; end-only → `expenses_to_<to>.csv`
- **Uncategorized** filter → `expenses_uncategorized.csv`
- **One** category selected → `expenses_<name>.csv`; **multiple** → `expenses_multiple_categories.csv`; **none** → `expenses_all_time.csv`

Unit tests already cover the logic of all three, so this pass is really about confirming the **wiring** in the live app. If you'd like, I can drive any of these flows for you with the `verify` skill and report what I observe.

```
  synchronously after the delegated click handler, so the create button
  detaches before the document click-outside listener runs, which then treated
  the detached target as an outside click. Fix handleClickOutside with an

  the receipt edit modal).
```

content.text:
I tested it, and this isn't a configurable Prettier rule. Prettier **hard-codes** the Markdown emphasis markers: italic always becomes `_foo_` and bold always `**foo**`. The only Markdown-related option Prettier exposes is `proseWrap` — there's no setting to pick `*` over `_`, and the maintainers have repeatedly declined to add one.

So there's no "rule" I can flip. The only way to keep your `*` is to stop Prettier from reformatting Markdown at all. Let me do that — exclude Markdown from Prettier so your authored emphasis is preserved:

Here's the full picture: **46 errors across 12 files**, 0 warnings. None are meaningfully auto-fixable (only the 2 `no-useless-escape` are). They fall into three tiers:

## Tier 1 — Deno edge functions (`supabase/functions/**`) — 26 errors
Not the SvelteKit app; these run on Deno and are external-API glue.
- `resend/index.ts` — **16× `no-explicit-any`**
- `_shared/mistral.ts` — 6× `no-explicit-any`, 2× `no-useless-escape` (`\-` in a regex), 1× `no-empty`
- `_shared/attachmentFiltering.test.ts` — 1× `no-explicit-any`

The config lints these with the same rules as the app (via `includeIgnoreFile`, with no Deno override). The `any`s are pervasive payload-shape glue — properly typing them is real work.

## Tier 2 — App source, care needed — 12 errors
Behavior-adjacent, need thought (not mechanical):
- `+layout.svelte` — **8× `svelte/no-navigation-without-resolve`** (nav `href`s must go through `resolve()`) + **1× `svelte/prefer-svelte-reactivity`** (a mutable `URLSearchParams` → `SvelteURLSearchParams`)
- `profile/+page.svelte` — 1× `no-navigation-without-resolve`
- `fileValidation.ts` — 2× `no-explicit-any`

## Tier 3 — Trivial, low-risk — 8 errors
Mechanical, safe to fix:
- Unused vars/imports: `login/+page.svelte` (`page`), `ReceiptImageViewer.svelte` (`isLoading`), `fileValidation.ts` (`fileName` param), `duplicateHelpers.spec.ts` (`createReceipt` — **the dead code the handoff already flagged** — + `filteredReceipts`), `tests/receipt-edit-modal.spec.ts` (`Page`)
- `svelte/require-each-key`: `CategoryFilter.svelte:115`, `admin/resize-images/+page.svelte:232` (add a key to `{#each}`)

## Recommended plan
The handoff's own note applies here: this is the "unknown ESLint debt in untouched files." I'd suggest:

1. **Tier 3 now** — pure cleanup, zero behavior risk, gets 8 errors gone fast.
2. **Tier 2 next** — `resolve()` on layout/profile links and the `SvelteURLSearchParams` swap; these touch navigation, so I'll verify the app still routes after.
3. **Tier 1 (Deno)** — decide between *typing* the payloads (accurate but sizable) vs. *scoping the rule down* for `supabase/functions/**` with a config override (these are external-API boundaries where `any` is arguably justified). This is the biggest chunk and a policy call.

Tier 3 + Tier 2 are done. **ESLint went from 46 → 26 errors**, and every remaining error is in the Deno edge functions (Tier 1), which we deliberately deferred.

## What changed

**Tier 3 — trivial (8 errors)**
- Removed dead unused vars/imports: `page` (login), `isLoading` (ReceiptImageViewer), `createReceipt` + `filteredReceipts` + now-unused `ReceiptRow` import (duplicateHelpers.spec), `Page` (receipt-edit-modal.spec).
- Added `{#each}` keys: `CategoryFilter.svelte` (`category.id`), `admin/resize-images` (`result.path`).

**Tier 2 — care-needed (12 errors)**
- `fileValidation.ts`: replaced two `x as any` with a type-safe `(readonly string[]).includes(...)`; renamed the unused `fileName` param → `_fileName` (callers still pass it, so no upstream cascade).
- Added `argsIgnorePattern`/`varsIgnorePattern`/`caughtErrorsIgnorePattern: '^_'` to `eslint.config.js` — a standard, lenient-only convention so `_`-prefixed intentionally-unused identifiers are allowed (created no new errors anywhere).

Why is _ pattern ok for unused params?

Good question — it's worth being precise, because "prefix it with `_`" is a convention, not a free pass, and I applied it deliberately to exactly one case (`_fileName`) while *deleting* the other unused things.

## The core distinction: parameters aren't like locals

An unused **local variable** or **import** is pure dead weight — nothing depends on it existing, so the correct fix is always to delete it. That's what I did for `page`, `isLoading`, `createReceipt`, `filteredReceipts`, `Page` in Tier 3.

A **parameter** is different: its *position* is part of the function's contract. You often can't remove it even when the body doesn't read it, because:
- A **later** param is used, so you can't drop an **earlier** one without shifting positions.
- The signature is dictated by something you don't control — a callback shape (`.map((_, i) => …)`), an event handler `(_e, s) => …`, a framework hook, or an interface it must match.
- Callers already pass it positionally, so removing it forces edits (or breaks them).

So for params there's a real category: **"required by the signature, but genuinely not read."** A bare unused param is ambiguous — it reads like *"oops, forgot to use this"* (a likely bug). The `_` prefix disambiguates: *"I know this is unused; it's here to satisfy the signature, on purpose."* It's the same idiom as Go's and Rust's `_`. `argsIgnorePattern: '^_'` just teaches ESLint to trust that marker.

## Why `_fileName` specifically, instead of deleting it

Deleting it would have **cascaded**: `validateFile(buffer, fileName)` is called by `processOcrFromBuffer`, whose *own* `fileName` param exists only to forward it — remove one and the next becomes "unused," and so on up the chain. And the param is plausibly a real part of the validator's API (its doc says "for logging"), just not wired yet. So `_fileName` keeps the contract intact and silences a *false* signal, rather than starting a refactor of the whole call chain to chase one lint error.

## The honest caveat

`_` is a **scalpel for "unused but required," not a blanket mute.** If a param has no reason to exist — no signature forcing it, no caller passing it, no intent — the right move is still to delete it and its call sites. The convention is only "ok" because it makes *intentional* unusedness explicit and greppable; it becomes a smell if people start `_`-prefixing things just to dodge the linter.

Also worth noting: the config change only *relaxes* the rule (exempts `^_`), so it can't introduce new errors anywhere — it purely gives us that intent-signaling escape hatch.

If you'd prefer the stricter stance, I can instead **remove** `fileName` end-to-end (validator → `processOcrFromBuffer` → the two call sites) so there's no `_`-param at all. It's a slightly wider diff but arguably cleaner, since the param is currently dead. Your call.

content.text:
Looked at all four. The honest answer: **three of the four can't actually be cleaned up** — they're not debt, they're the language's required way to say "I need arg 2 but not arg 1." Only one is genuinely fixable.

## Per-item difficulty

**#1 `_e` (layout) & #2 `_event` (profile) — not fixable.**
Supabase calls `onAuthStateChange(cb)` with `cb(event, session)`. Both callbacks use `session` (arg 2) but not `event` (arg 1). In JS a positional param can't be skipped — you must declare arg 1 to reach arg 2, and the signature is dictated by Supabase, not us. The only ways to drop the param would be to *use* the event (a behavior change) or stop using the pushed session and poll `getSession()` instead (worse, and changes semantics). The `_event` prefix is the correct, permanent idiom here.

**#3 `_id` (appMocks stub) — not fixable.**
`update<T>(_id, patch)` deliberately mirrors the real `ReceiptService.update(id, patch)` so the page's `update(receipt.id, patch)` call typechecks. `patch` (arg 2) is returned; `_id` (arg 1) is a required positional placeholder. Same story — irreducible.

**#4 `_label` (transactionFilters.spec) — easy (~2 min, zero risk).**
This is the only real one. It uses tuple rows `['dateFrom', {…}]` and needs only the second element. Switch to object rows and destructure:
```ts
it.each([
  { label: 'dateFrom', criteria: { dateFrom: '2025-12-01' } },
  … 
])('is true when only $label is active', ({ criteria }) => {
  expect(hasActiveTransactionFilters(criteria)).toBe(true);
});
```
`$label` interpolates the name; `{ criteria }` drops the unused param. Same assertions, no positional placeholder.

The premise "all need to be fixed" doesn't hold: **#1–#3 are correct as-is** — the underscore isn't a workaround being paid down, it's the idiomatic expression of a required-but-unread param. Forcing them out makes the code worse. Only **#4** is worth doing.

# YFL Expense Tracker

Family expense tracking app built with SvelteKit 2, Svelte 5, Supabase, and Tailwind CSS 4.

## Commands

```bash
npm run dev          # Dev server on localhost:5173
npm run build        # Production build
npm run check        # Type checking (svelte-check)
npm run test:unit    # Vitest unit tests
npm run test:e2e     # Playwright e2e tests
npm test             # Full test suite (unit + e2e)
npm run lint         # Prettier check + ESLint
npm run format       # Auto-format with Prettier
```

## Architecture

- **Routes:** `src/routes/` — SvelteKit file-based routing
- **Services:** `src/lib/services/` — Business logic (ExpenseService, ReceiptService, etc.). Some use DI (take Supabase client as param), others use singleton pattern with module-level import.
- **Models:** `src/lib/models/` — TypeScript data models
- **Components:** `src/lib/components/` — Reusable Svelte components
- **Utils:** `src/lib/utils/` — Helper functions with co-located `.spec.ts` tests
- **Server:** `src/lib/server/` — Server-only code (file validation, OCR processing)
- **CSV Parsers:** `src/lib/services/csvParsers/` — Bank-specific CSV parsers (Amex, PC Financial, RBC, TD, Simplii, EQ Bank, Wealth Simple) with `BaseCSVParser` and `CSVParserFactory` for auto-detection
- **Docs:** `docs/` — Project documentation. `docs/adr/` (architecture decision records), `docs/plans/` (design docs), `docs/prd-*.md` (PRDs — status tracked via front-matter, not folder), `docs/product-backlog.md` (the single working list — features, bugs, engineering, and open refactoring items as one-liners) plus `docs/refactoring-backlog.md` (detailed RF-NN reference, not a separate to-do list), `docs/domain-model.md` (ubiquitous-language glossary). Prefer `docs/` over root for any new note or plan; the root keeps only `README.md` and `CLAUDE.md`.
- **Migrations:** `supabase/migrations/` — SQL migrations (schema + RLS policies)

## Supabase Migrations

Migrations live in `supabase/migrations/` as numbered SQL files. The project is linked to the remote Supabase project (`YFL Expense Tracker`, region `ca-central-1`).

```bash
supabase migration list           # Show local vs remote migration status
supabase db push                  # Push pending migrations to remote database
supabase db push --dry-run        # Preview what would be applied without running
supabase migration new <name>     # Create a new empty migration file
supabase db diff --schema public  # Generate migration from local schema changes
supabase db reset                 # Reset local DB and re-run all migrations (destructive)
```

**Naming convention:** `YYYYMMDD_description.sql` (e.g. `20260225_secure_receipts_storage.sql`). Some older migrations use sequential numbering (`001_init.sql`).

**Important:** The migration role does NOT own `storage.objects`, so `COMMENT ON POLICY` and `ALTER TABLE` on storage tables will fail. Stick to `CREATE POLICY` / `DROP POLICY` / `UPDATE storage.buckets` for storage changes.

## Key Patterns

- **Expenses are computed, not stored.** No "expenses" table — expenses are joins of receipts + expense_categories + categories. Each receipt maps to exactly one expense (1:1).
- **All data is family-scoped.** Users belong to families via `family_members`. RLS policies enforce family-level access on receipts, transactions, categories, and vendor rules.
- **Receipt storage is private.** The `receipts` bucket is private — all file access uses signed URLs via `getSignedReceiptUrl()` from `src/lib/utils/signedUrl.ts`. Pages cache signed URLs in a reactive `signedUrls` map loaded via `$effect`. OCR uses short-lived signed URLs (5 min expiry). Display uses 1-hour expiry.
- **Storage RLS is family-scoped for reads.** Family members can read each other's receipt files. Write/delete is restricted to the file owner (path prefix = `user_id`).
- **Auto-categorization:** Vendor rules map normalized merchant names to categories. Applied on page load for uncategorized expenses. Normalization: lowercase, strip special chars, trim.
- **Date pickers use flowbite-svelte.** Always use `<Datepicker>` from `flowbite-svelte` with `toDate()` and `toISODateString()` helpers from `$lib/utils/dateConversion`. Never use raw `<input type="date">`.
- **Never use `new Date("YYYY-MM-DD")` for date-only strings.** JavaScript parses bare date strings as UTC midnight, which shifts to the previous day in timezones west of UTC. Always use `toDate()` to parse or `formatDate()` to display — both from `$lib/utils/dateConversion`. These parse year/month/day parts manually to construct local-time Date objects.
- **Date filters preserved in URL** via `preserveFilters()` helper in `+layout.svelte`.
- **Version tracking** in `src/lib/version.ts`. Increment by 0.01 for small changes, 0.1 for features.
- **Transaction amounts: negative = expense, positive = refund/credit.** This matches the UI display (red = negative = expense, green = positive = credit). Most banks (PC Financial, EQ Bank, RBC, TD, Simplii) already use negative for expenses so parsers keep signs as-is (`invertSign: false`). Only American Express uses positive for expenses and needs `invertSign: true`. Wealth Simple CSV exports have inconsistent signs across downloads, so the parser uses the `type` column (Purchase → negative, Payment/Refund → positive) instead of `invertSign`. See `BaseCSVParser.normalizeAmount()`.
- **XLS/XLSX import supported.** Excel files are converted to CSV via `ExcelToCSVConverter` (SheetJS) before passing through the same parser pipeline. File type detected by extension/MIME.

## Gotchas

- Dual test environments: browser tests use Playwright provider, server tests use Node.js — configured in `vite.config.ts` under `test.projects`
- PDFs go directly to Mistral Vision API (pixtral-12b) — no conversion needed
- Suspicious date flag triggers for receipts >42 days old or future-dated
- Multi-email support: primary email in `auth.users`, up to 5 additional in `profiles` table. Email receipt ingestion checks both.
- File uploads: JPEG/PNG/HEIC up to 5MB, PDF up to 10MB. Validated client-side and server-side (`src/lib/server/fileValidation.ts`)
- Recent migrations (Jan–Feb 2026) refactored family-scoping, fixed RLS recursion issues, and secured storage — be careful modifying RLS policies
- Receipt image URLs are async (signed URLs). Components use `$effect` + `Promise.then()` to load them, not synchronous calls. Never use `getPublicUrl()`.
- Transaction imports accept CSV, XLS, and XLSX files. Excel files are read as ArrayBuffer and converted to CSV text before parsing.
- The `transactions` table uses `excluded` (boolean) for soft-delete. The UI shows "Exclude/Include" buttons. The database column was originally named `ignored` in older code paths.
- Debugging Resend (email receipts): start at <https://resend.com/webhooks> — it shows the endpoint **Signing Secret** (`whsec_…`, must equal Supabase's `RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET`) and the delivery log with the status our `resend` function returned. The webhook fails closed: `401` = signature mismatch, `500` = secret not configured. See `docs/email-notifications.md`.
- Image resize before upload: client-side, native Canvas (zero deps), 2000px longest axis, 85% quality, JPEG/PNG only (skips PDF + HEIC), falls back to the original file on any failure. Wired in `ReceiptService.uploadAndCreate()`; logic in `src/lib/utils/imageResize.ts`.
- `overflow-x-auto` clips dropdowns in BOTH axes: a wrapper whose `overflow-x` is non-visible has its computed `overflow-y` become `auto` (not `visible`), so `overflow-x-auto` on a table wrapper clips absolutely-positioned dropdown menus vertically too. Keep the expenses table wrapper free of it; position menus with `right-0`.
- Date-parsing correction vs flag windows: OCR date correction uses a 90-day window (`PLAUSIBILITY_WINDOW_DAYS`) while the suspicious-date FLAG uses 42 days — a 43–90-day date can be auto-accepted by the parser yet still flagged. Two failure modes: format-ambiguity (auto-fixable) vs wrong-token extraction (only flaggable). Ruled out — do not reintroduce: prompt-tuning date interpretation, using the matched bank-transaction date as truth (circular), extracting all date tokens. `raw_date_text` is transient (never persisted); the `supabase/functions/_shared/` Deno copy of the correction logic must stay in lock-step with `src/lib/utils/`.
- Password policy: 16-char minimum (NIST length-over-complexity), at least one of upper/lower/number/special, exact confirmation match (whitespace-preserving, case-sensitive). Constants/messages exported from `src/lib/utils/passwordValidation.ts`.

Public (browser): `PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, `PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`
Private (server): `MISTRAL_API_KEY`, `RESEND_API_KEY`, `RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, `RESEND_FROM_EMAIL` (sender for notification emails — MUST be an address on a domain verified in Resend, or every send returns 403 "Request is forbidden"; consumed by `supabase/functions/_shared/notify.ts`)

```ts
it.each([
```

content.text:
Tier 1 is done — I **typed the payloads** rather than relaxing the rule, so `npm run lint` is now fully green (exit 0) across the entire repo for the first time.

## What I fixed (26 → 0)

**`resend/index.ts` (16 `any`)**
- Added `type SupabaseClient = ReturnType<typeof createServiceClient>` and threaded it through the four `supabase:` params. (Naïvely using `ReturnType<typeof createClient>` didn't match the real instance's generics — `deno check` caught it — so I extracted a `createServiceClient` factory and derived the alias from *that*, which matches the call site exactly.)
- `InsertedReceipt` interface for the insert helpers' return (only `id`/`merchant_name`/`total_amount` are read).
- `errText(e: unknown)` helper replacing the five `(e as any)?.message` catch patterns.
- Added optional `content_id`/`content_disposition` to `ResendAttachment` (the runtime object has them) → dropped the `(att as any)` casts.
- `jsonResponse(body: unknown)`.

**`_shared/mistral.ts` (6 `any` + 2 escape + 1 empty)**
- `RawOcrContent` interface for the parsed model JSON; typed env accessor; hoisted the duplicated `toNum` to module scope as `toNum(v: unknown)`.
- Fixed the useless `\-` escape (`[^0-9.-]`) and gave the empty `catch {}` a comment.

**`attachmentFiltering.test.ts` (1 `any`)** — removed a redundant `{} as any` (plain `{}` already typechecks, as the sibling test shows).

Also removed the now-unnecessary `// deno-lint-ignore-file no-explicit-any` directives from both source files.

## Verification
- `npm run lint`: **exit 0** (prettier + eslint, whole repo).
- `deno check` on both edited source files: **type-checks clean** (this is what caught the SupabaseClient generics mismatch — worth having in the toolbox for these files, since repo `svelte-check` doesn't cover `supabase/functions`).
- Full vitest suite: **1320 passed / 8 skipped**; the vitest-run `attachmentFiltering.test.ts` 45/45.
- Backlog item marked ✅ DONE.

## One honest caveat
These Deno functions have **no automated test coverage** (that's the separate Resend-handler-testability PRD), so I relied on type-checking + behavior-preserving edits. Every change is either a pure type annotation or a mechanical refactor (`errText`, hoisted `toNum`, the client factory) with identical runtime behavior — nothing changes what the webhook actually does. If you want belt-and-suspenders before deploying, the `verify`/manual path would be exercising a real Resend webhook, but there's no runtime behavior change here to chase.

Two pre-existing things I deliberately left (out of scope): the `deno lint` `no-import-prefix` hints on the `esm.sh` URLs, and the untested-handler PRD.
Is now the time to implement "Resend-handler-testability PRD"?
Let me read the PRD and check the current test setup before advising — I don't want to opine on timing without knowing the actual scope.

## 1. Problem

`supabase/functions/resend/index.ts` calls `Deno.serve(async (req) => { … })` at
module top level. Importing the module therefore starts a server and requires the
`Deno` global, so it **cannot be loaded under vitest**. As a result the handler's
_orchestration_ has **zero automated coverage**:

- the auth/validation gates — `405` (non-POST), `400` (bad JSON / missing type /
  unparseable sender), `500` (missing env / missing signing secret), `401`
  (bad signature), `404` (unknown sender / no receipt found);

  attachment loop, the body-text fallback, suspicious-date warnings, foreign-
  currency rate lookup;

  "failing silently for 30 days" bug, where a failed send must now write a row to

Only the extracted pure helpers are tested today (`notify.ts`, `emailParsing.ts`,

Extracting more pure helpers never covers the branching above — that logic lives
in the shell, and the shell is precisely where the recent bugs were (unknown
sender → 404, silent notification failure, disabled signature check).

This is the "Option A" from the debugging session: **functional core, imperative
shell** — separate the handler from `Deno.serve` and inject its collaborators so
the branch matrix can be tested in the runner we already use (vitest).

## 2. Goals / non-goals

### Goals

- The webhook's request→response behaviour is unit-testable in vitest with **no
  network, no live Supabase, no Deno runtime** — deterministic and fast.
- Cover the full branch matrix in §5 with fakes.

  does today.

- Not adopting a second test runner (`deno test`) — considered and rejected below.
- Not building a local `supabase functions serve` integration suite (that's an

- Not re-litigating the OCR/exchange-rate/notification logic — only how it's wired.

## 3. Proposed design

Split the module into a **testable core** (an exported async function) and an
**untested shell** (the one-line `Deno.serve` binding that wires real deps).

```ts

	now: () => Date; // replaces new Date() — makes suspicious-date + timestamps deterministic
	ocr: OcrPort; // processEmailText / textToImage / ocrFromUrl
	exchangeRate: (currency: string, date: string) => Promise<number | null>;

export async function handleResendWebhook(req: Request, deps: WebhookDeps): Promise<Response> {
	// the current handler body, with every Deno.env.get / global fetch /
	// createClient / new Date() / mistral / exchangeRate call routed through `deps`
}

// index.ts — shell (the only Deno-bound code left, kept trivial and untested)
Deno.serve((req) =>
	handleResendWebhook(req, {
		supabase: createClient(
			Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!,
			Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!
		),
		fetchFn: fetch,
		env: (k) => Deno.env.get(k),
```

  own correctness; the wiring layer just proves it's connected).

## 4. Success metrics

- `handleResendWebhook` is imported and exercised by a vitest suite; the branch
  matrix in §5 is green.
- No production behaviour change (verified by `deno check` + a manual smoke of one
  real forwarded receipt after deploy).
- New regressions in the handler's control flow are caught by the suite, not in

| 11  | body-text receipt, no attachments                        | insert + **success** notification                                    |
| 12  | body-text receipt, suspicious date                       | insert `suspicious_date=true` + **warning** notification             |
| 13  | supported attachment → OCR ok                            | insert + **success** notification                                    |
